workouts.title: Upper Body & Core
workouts.subtitle: Wed, Jul 22 · Midday window

items.name: Arm circles, band pull-aparts, scap push-ups
items.detail: 10 arm circles each direction, 15 band pull-aparts, 10 scap push-ups. Keep it light — just getting blood into shoulders and upper back before loading.

items.name: DB Bench Press
items.detail: Pick a weight where the last 2 reps of each set feel challenging but controlled — not grinding. At 6/10 today, leave 2-3 reps in the tank.

items.name: DB Rows
items.detail: Bench-supported or bent-over, controlled tempo, squeeze at the top. Full range of motion matters more than heavy weight here.

items.name: DB Shoulder Press
items.detail: Seated or standing. Moderate weight — this is a resume week, not a max-testing week. Smooth reps, no back arch.

items.name: Face Pulls
items.detail: Cable or band, elbows high, pause and squeeze the rear delts/upper back at the end range. Light-moderate weight, focus on posture.

items.name: Pallof Press
items.detail: Cable or band, anti-rotation press. Brace the core, resist the pull to rotate. This is the running/cycling stability piece — quality over speed.

items.name: Side Plank
items.detail: Stack hips, straight line shoulder to ankle. If 40s is easy, add a top-arm reach-under for extra rotation challenge.

items.name: Chest, lat, and hip flexor stretch
items.detail: Doorway chest stretch, overhead lat stretch, kneeling hip flexor stretch. Easy breathing, let heart rate settle before the evening.

workouts.title: Lower Body & Core
workouts.subtitle: Sat, Jul 25 · Pair with today's ride

items.name: Leg swings, bodyweight squats, hip circles
items.detail: 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 10 bodyweight squats, 10 hip circles each way. Get the hips and knees moving before loading.

items.name: Goblet Squats
items.detail: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height. Full depth, controlled tempo. Still reintroduction week — leave 2-3 reps in the tank.

items.name: RDLs
items.detail: Dumbbell or barbell, soft knees, hinge at the hips, feel the hamstring stretch. Keep the weight close to your legs the whole way down.

items.name: Walking Lunges
items.detail: Bodyweight or light dumbbells. Long enough stride that the front knee tracks over the ankle, not past the toes.

items.name: Glute Bridges
items.detail: Feet flat, drive through the heels, squeeze glutes hard at the top for a full second before lowering.

items.name: Dead Bugs
items.detail: Lower back pressed flat into the floor the entire time. Slow, controlled opposite arm/leg extension.

items.name: Plank
items.detail: Forearms down, straight line from shoulders to ankles, ribs pulled down. Breathe normally throughout.

items.name: Quad, hamstring, hip flexor stretch
items.detail: Standing quad stretch, seated/standing hamstring stretch, kneeling hip flexor stretch. Keeps the hips from tightening up on a ride day.

workouts.title: Arms & Core Focus
workouts.subtitle: Sun, Jul 26 · Swapped in — legs resting after FTP test + 8mi run

items.name: Arm circles, band pull-aparts, wrist mobility
items.detail: 10 arm circles each direction, 15 band pull-aparts, 10 wrist circles each way. Legs are resting today — this is purely an arms and core session, so keep the warm-up focused on upper body.

items.name: DB Bicep Curl
items.detail: Controlled tempo, no swinging. Moderate weight — today's about quality volume, not maxing out on a day you're also riding.

items.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
items.detail: Single DB or rope attachment overhead, elbows stay close to the head, full stretch at the bottom.

items.name: Hammer Curl
items.detail: Neutral grip, hits the brachialis for arm thickness alongside the standard curls.

items.name: Tricep Dips
items.detail: Bench or dip station. Elbows track back, not out to the sides. Add feet elevation if bodyweight feels too easy.

items.name: 21s Curl + Close-Grip Push-Up Superset
items.detail: 21s: 7 bottom-half reps, 7 top-half reps, 7 full-range reps, no rest between — that's one curl set. Straight into close-grip push-ups after. Finisher for the arms.

items.name: Pallof Press
items.detail: Cable or band, anti-rotation press. Extra core volume today since legs are off — good chance to really dial in the posture/stability work.

items.name: Hollow Hold
items.detail: Lower back pressed flat, arms and legs extended. Hold the brace the whole time.

items.name: Dead Bug
items.detail: Slow, controlled opposite arm/leg extension, lower back stays flat throughout.

items.name: Side Plank
items.detail: Stack hips, straight line shoulder to ankle. Add a reach-under if it's too easy.

items.name: Russian Twists
items.detail: Controlled rotation, not rushed. Add light weight if bodyweight feels too easy.

items.name: Arm and shoulder stretch
items.detail: Overhead tricep stretch, cross-body shoulder stretch, wrist flexor/extensor stretch. Take it easy — you've still got the ride today too.

workouts.title: Day B — Deadlift/Pull + Core
workouts.subtitle: Wed, Jul 29 · Midday window before date night · Felt 5/10, planned 7/10

items.name: Leg swings, glute bridges, cat-cow, band pull-aparts
items.detail: 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 10 glute bridges, 10 cat-cow, 15 band pull-aparts. This week's had a lot of volume — take the warm-up seriously and check in with how the legs feel before loading the deadlift.

items.name: Deadlift
items.detail: Standard full-body split day. Given the week's volume (FTP test, 8mi run, 25mi ride, 5K test), listen to the first working set — if it feels unusually flat, trim 5-10% off the top weight rather than forcing it. Reset fully between reps, brace hard.

items.name: Pull-Ups or TRX Rows
items.detail: Pull-ups if you have a bar handy, TRX rows as the equipment-flexible substitute. Full range of motion, controlled negative.

items.name: Ab Wheel Rollouts or Hanging Leg Raises
items.detail: Ab wheel if you want the anti-extension challenge, hanging leg raises as the alternative. Keep the lower back from arching — that's the whole point of this movement.

items.name: Dead Bugs
items.detail: Lower back pressed flat, slow controlled opposite arm/leg extension.

items.name: Single-Arm Farmer Carry
items.detail: Heavy dumbbell or kettlebell, resist leaning to the loaded side. Builds the anti-lateral-flexion strength that carries over to both running and cycling posture.

items.name: EMOM: Min 1 wall balls/thrusters, Min 2 KB swings, Min 3 rower sprint
items.detail: Minute 1: 12 wall balls or DB thrusters. Minute 2: 15 KB swings. Minute 3: 30 sec rower sprint, rest remainder of that minute. Repeat for 4 full rounds. Given the week's fatigue, it's fine to dial intensity here to what feels sustainable rather than max effort.

items.name: Hip flexor, hamstring, lat stretch
items.detail: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, seated hamstring stretch, overhead lat stretch. Extra attention to the posterior chain today given the deadlifts on top of this week's run/ride volume.

workouts.title: Day A — Squat/Press + Core
workouts.subtitle: Mon, Aug 3 · Foundation Phase, Week 1

items.name: Bodyweight squats, leg swings, arm circles, band pull-aparts
items.detail: 10 bodyweight squats, 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 10 arm circles each direction, 15 band pull-aparts. First lifting session of the new Foundation phase — take the warm-up seriously and re-establish good movement patterns.

items.name: Back Squat
items.detail: Based on your 215 lb 5-rep max. Foundation phase priority: re-establish working weights and perfect form, not chase numbers. Full depth, controlled tempo. Adjust up or down slightly based on how the first working set feels — same approach as the deadlift calibration.

items.name: Push Press
items.detail: Slight dip and drive from the legs into the press. Moderate weight, focus on the explosive leg drive transferring into a clean overhead lockout.

items.name: Hollow Hold
items.detail: Lower back pressed flat, arms and legs extended. Anti-extension strength that braces the torso for squats and stabilizes the bike position.

items.name: Pallof Press
items.detail: Cable or band, anti-rotation press. Brace the core, resist the pull to rotate.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.detail: Slow and controlled, opposite arm/leg extension. Stabilizes the pelvis for running form and saddle position.

items.name: AMRAP: 10 KB swings, 10 box jumps/step-ups, 200m row, 10 push-ups
items.sub: As many rounds as possible in 10-12 min
items.detail: Moderate intensity to build work capacity this early in the phase — not an all-out effort. Steady, sustainable pace across all rounds.

items.name: Quad, hip flexor, chest stretch
items.detail: Standing quad stretch, kneeling hip flexor stretch, doorway chest stretch. Standard cooldown to close out the first Foundation-phase session.

workouts.title: Day B — Hinge/Pull + Core
workouts.subtitle: Wed, Aug 5 · Foundation Phase, Week 1 · Before date night

items.name: Leg swings, glute bridges, cat-cow, band pull-aparts
items.detail: 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 10 glute bridges, 10 cat-cow, 15 band pull-aparts. Get the hips and hamstrings ready before loading the deadlift.

items.name: Deadlift
items.detail: Based on your 225 lb 5-rep max — 185 lbs felt easy last time (RPE 5 vs. planned RPE 7), so this session steps up to a weight that should actually challenge reps 4-5 while keeping form clean. Adjust up or down slightly based on how the first working set feels.

items.name: Pull-Ups or TRX Rows
items.detail: Pull-ups if you have a bar, TRX rows as the flexible substitute. Full range of motion, controlled negative on both.

items.name: Ab Wheel Rollouts or Hanging Leg Raises
items.detail: Ab wheel for the anti-extension challenge, hanging leg raises as the alternative. Keep the lower back from arching.

items.name: Dead Bugs
items.detail: Lower back pressed flat, slow controlled opposite arm/leg extension.

items.name: Single-Arm Farmer Carry
items.detail: Heavy dumbbell or kettlebell, resist leaning to the loaded side. Builds anti-lateral-flexion strength for running and cycling posture.

items.name: EMOM: Min 1 wall balls/thrusters, Min 2 KB swings, Min 3 rower sprint
items.detail: Minute 1: 12 wall balls or DB thrusters. Minute 2: 15 KB swings. Minute 3: 30 sec rower sprint, rest remainder of that minute. Repeat for 4 full rounds. Moderate intensity — building work capacity, not maxing out this early in the phase.

items.name: Hip flexor, hamstring, lat stretch
items.detail: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, seated hamstring stretch, overhead lat stretch. You've got date night after, so give the posterior chain a proper cooldown.

workouts.subtitle: Mon, Aug 10 · Foundation Phase, Week 2

items.detail: 10 bodyweight squats, 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 10 arm circles each direction, 15 band pull-aparts.

Devil Press = burpee with two dumbbells, snatched overhead at the top; sub DB Thrusters if that's too much for the day. Steady, sustainable pace across all rounds.

items.name: Quad, hip flexor, chest stretch

items.name: Leg swings, glute bridges, cat-cow, band pull-aparts
items.detail: 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 10 glute bridges, 10 cat-cow, 15 band pull-aparts.

items.name: Deadlift
items.detail: Based on your 225 lb 5-rep max. Full reset between reps, brace hard before every pull. Adjust based on how the first working set feels.

items.name: Pull-Ups or TRX Rows
items.detail: Pull-ups if you have a bar, TRX rows as the flexible substitute. Full range of motion, controlled negative on both.

items.name: Ab Wheel Rollouts or Hanging Leg Raises

items.name: EMOM: Min 1 Russian Twists/Med Ball Slams, Min 2 Renegade Rows, Min 3 Battle Ropes/Jumping Lunges
items.detail: Minute 1: 12 Russian twists/side or 12 med ball slams. Minute 2: 10 renegade rows/side. Minute 3: 15 battle rope waves or 20 jumping lunges/side. Fresh rotation/anti-rotation and upper-pressing focus this week compared to the usual wall balls/KB swings/rower combo.

items.name: Hip flexor, hamstring, lat stretch
items.detail: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, seated hamstring stretch, overhead lat stretch. You've got date night after, so give the posterior chain a proper cooldown.

workouts.title: Full Body HIIT
workouts.subtitle: Fallback · No scheduled date

items.name: Jumping jacks, high knees, walkouts, arm circles
items.detail: 30s jumping jacks, 30s high knees, 5 walkouts, 10 arm circles each direction. Second round faster than the first — get the heart rate up before loading anything heavy.

items.name: Front Squat to Push Press
items.detail: Load it moderate-heavy but move it fast — drive up out of the squat straight into the press. This is about power output, not a grind. RPE 9 today means minimal rest and real intent behind every rep.

items.name: Box Jumps
items.detail: Full hip extension and stick the landing before resetting. Step down rather than jumping down to save the knees for the rest of the session.

items.name: Round Format: 5 rounds
items.detail: Burpees x15, KB Swings x20, Rower 250m sprint, Wall Balls x15, Mountain Climbers x30 (15/side). Move through all 5 exercises back-to-back with minimal transition time, then rest before the next round. This is the RPE 9 engine — by round 3-4 it should hurt.

items.name: Burpees
items.detail: Full chest-to-floor, explosive jump at the top. First movement of each round — set the pace hard.

items.name: KB Swings
items.detail: Hip-hinge power, not a shoulder raise. Snap the hips through on every rep.

items.name: Rower 250m
items.detail: This is a sprint, not a steady pace — empty the tank for the 250m, then move straight into wall balls.

items.name: Wall Balls
items.detail: Full squat depth, hit the target, catch and reset immediately. Legs will be cooked by round 3 — push through.

items.name: Mountain Climbers
items.detail: Fast, controlled, hips low. This is the last movement before the round rest — leave nothing in the tank here.

items.name: Plank-to-Push-Up + Hollow Rocks
items.detail: Fast-paced burnout to close things out. Plank-to-push-ups alternate leading arms; hollow rocks stay tight through the low back the whole time.

items.name: Full-body stretch
items.detail: Hip flexors, hamstrings, quads, chest, and lats. Breathe slow and deep — heart rate should be well settled before you stop.

workouts.title: Full Body HIIT — Max Effort
workouts.subtitle: Fallback · No scheduled date

items.name: Jumping jacks, high knees, walkouts, arm circles
items.detail: 30s jumping jacks, 30s high knees, 5 walkouts, 10 arm circles each direction. Push the second round harder than usual — today's session goes out fast, so the body needs to be ready sooner.

items.name: Thrusters
items.detail: Front squat straight into a press, no pause at the top of the squat. Heavy enough that rep 5 is genuinely hard — this sets the tone for RPE 10.

items.name: Round Format: 5 rounds, max pace
items.detail: Devil Press x12, Rower 300m sprint, Burpee Box Jump Overs x12, Wall Balls x20, KB Swings x25 (heavy). Unbroken if possible within each round — this is an all-out effort, not a pacing exercise. By round 3 you should be questioning the plan.

items.name: Devil Press
items.detail: Burpee with two dumbbells, snatch them overhead at the top. Brutal but efficient — full body every rep.

items.name: Rower 300m
items.detail: Empty the tank. This should feel uncomfortable by 200m in.

items.name: Burpee Box Jump Overs
items.detail: Burpee, then jump over the box rather than onto it. Keep moving even if the jump gets sloppy late in the round.

items.name: Wall Balls
items.detail: Full depth squat, hit the target every rep. Legs will be shredded from the box jump overs — push through anyway.

items.name: KB Swings
items.detail: Heavier than your usual swings today. Hip snap does the work — don't let fatigue turn this into an arm exercise.

items.name: Weighted Plank + Hollow Rock Hold
items.detail: Plate on the back for the plank if you have one handy. Hollow rocks stay tight through the low back — this is the last thing standing between you and being done, make it count.

items.name: Full-body stretch
items.detail: Hip flexors, hamstrings, quads, chest, and lats. Take longer than usual here — RPE 10 sessions need real recovery attention afterward.

workouts.title: Full Body HIIT — Hard but Controlled
workouts.subtitle: Fallback · No scheduled date

items.name: Jumping jacks, high knees, walkouts, arm circles
items.detail: 30s jumping jacks, 30s high knees, 5 walkouts, 10 arm circles each direction. Standard warm-up pace — today's session is hard but controlled, not an all-out sprint from the start.

items.name: Deadlift to Overhead Press
items.detail: Deadlift the bar or dumbbells up, then press overhead from the hang or shoulder. Controlled tempo — challenging by rep 6, but form stays clean throughout.

items.name: Round Format: 4 rounds
items.detail: KB Swings x20, Rower 200m, Box Step-Ups x16 (8/leg), Push-Ups x15, Plank hold 30s. A full 90s rest between rounds keeps this hard but sustainable — quality reps over sheer chaos.

items.name: KB Swings
items.detail: Hip-hinge power, controlled tempo. This should feel demanding but repeatable across all 4 rounds.

items.name: Rower 200m
items.detail: Hard effort but not a max sprint — aim for a pace you could hold evenly across all 4 rounds.

items.name: Box Step-Ups
items.detail: Full stand at the top, control the step down. Add dumbbells if bodyweight feels too easy by round 2.

items.name: Push-Ups
items.detail: Chest to floor, full lockout at the top. Drop to knees if form breaks down late in the round rather than grinding out sloppy reps.

items.name: Plank Hold
items.detail: Straight line, ribs down, steady breathing. Last movement of the round before the longer rest.

items.name: Hollow Hold + Russian Twists
items.detail: Hollow hold with lower back pressed flat. Russian twists controlled, not rushed — rotation quality matters more than speed here.

items.name: Full-body stretch
items.detail: Hip flexors, hamstrings, quads, chest, and lats. Standard cooldown to close out the session.

workouts.title: Upper Body Definition
workouts.subtitle: Fallback · No scheduled date

items.name: Band pull-aparts, arm circles, scap push-ups
items.detail: 15 band pull-aparts, 10 arm circles each direction, 10 scap push-ups. Get blood into the shoulders and upper back before the higher-rep work ahead.

items.name: DB Bench Press
items.detail: Lighter than your strength-day bench weight — this is about volume and time under tension for definition, not maxing out. Controlled 2-count lowering phase.

items.name: DB Incline Flyes
items.detail: Slight bend in the elbows throughout, feel the stretch across the chest at the bottom. Light-moderate weight — this is a shaping movement, not a strength builder.

items.name: Seated Cable Row
items.detail: Full stretch forward, squeeze the shoulder blades together at the back of each rep. Controlled tempo builds the back width/definition look.

items.name: Lateral Raises
items.detail: Light weight, slight forward lean, lead with the elbows. This shapes shoulder width — resist the urge to go heavy here.

items.name: Bicep Curl + Tricep Pushdown Superset
items.sub: 3 rounds × 12 reps each, no rest between exercises
items.detail: Straight into tricep pushdowns right after curls, no rest between the two. Rest 45s only after completing both, then repeat. This is the pump-focused piece for visible arm definition.

items.name: Pallof Press
items.detail: Cable or band, anti-rotation press. Same posture/stability purpose as always — brace and resist the pull to rotate.

items.name: Side Plank
items.detail: Stack hips, straight line shoulder to ankle. Add a reach-under if 40s feels too easy.

items.name: Chest, lat, and shoulder stretch
items.detail: Doorway chest stretch, overhead lat stretch, cross-body shoulder stretch. Let the arms and chest settle after the higher-volume work.

workouts.title: Upper Body Definition — High Intensity
workouts.subtitle: Fallback · No scheduled date

items.name: Band pull-aparts, arm circles, scap push-ups
items.detail: 15 band pull-aparts, 10 arm circles each direction, 10 scap push-ups. Second round faster — today's volume is high, get the joints ready.

items.name: DB Bench Press Drop Sets
items.sub: 4 sets × 8 reps, then drop weight ~20% for 8 more, no rest between
items.detail: Hit 8 reps at your working weight, immediately grab lighter dumbbells and knock out 8 more with no rest. That full drop set is one 'set' — rest 75s only after the drop, then repeat.

items.name: Push-Pull Superset: DB Row + DB Shoulder Press
items.sub: 4 rounds × 10 reps each, no rest between
items.detail: Row straight into press with no rest between the two movements. Rest 45s only after completing both, then repeat. This keeps the whole upper body under tension.

items.name: Round Format: 4 rounds, fast pace
items.detail: Lateral Raises x15, Face Pulls x15, Push-ups to failure. Move through all three back-to-back, then rest 30s before the next round. By round 3 the shoulders should be burning.

items.name: Lateral Raises
items.detail: Light weight is the point here — this is about burning out the delts for that capped-shoulder look, not moving heavy loads.

items.name: Face Pulls
items.detail: Elbows high, squeeze the rear delts and upper back at the end range.

items.name: Push-ups to Failure
items.detail: Go until form breaks down, not just until it's hard. This closes out each round before the between-round rest.

items.name: Bicep Curl 21s + Tricep Dips
items.detail: 21s: 7 reps bottom-half range, 7 reps top-half range, 7 reps full range, all without rest — that's one bicep set. Straight into 15 tricep dips after. This is the definition-focused burnout to finish the arms.

items.name: Hollow Hold
items.detail: Lower back pressed flat, arms and legs extended. Hold the brace the entire 40s — this is demanding after all the upper body volume, that's the point.

items.name: Russian Twists
items.detail: Controlled rotation, not rushed. Add weight if bodyweight feels too easy.

items.name: Chest, lat, and shoulder stretch
items.detail: Doorway chest stretch, overhead lat stretch, cross-body shoulder stretch. Take extra time here — this session runs hot, recovery matters.

workouts.title: Camp Bodyweight — Push/Pull
workouts.subtitle: Fallback · No equipment, ~20 min · Camping trip

items.name: Arm circles, walkouts, standing good mornings
items.detail: 10 arm circles each direction, 5 walkouts, 10 standing good mornings. No equipment needed — just get the shoulders, hips, and hamstrings moving before the circuit.

items.name: Push-Ups
items.detail: Chest to ground, full lockout at the top. Drop to knees if form breaks down late in the circuit rather than grinding sloppy reps.

items.name: Pike Push-Ups
items.detail: Hips high in a pike/inverted-V position, hands and feet on the ground, lower the head toward the floor between the hands. This is your shoulder-press substitute with zero equipment.

items.name: Superman Pulls
items.detail: Lie face-down, arms extended overhead. Lift chest, arms, and legs off the ground together (the 'Superman' position), then pull the elbows back toward the ribs like a rowing motion, squeezing the shoulder blades together, before extending back out overhead. Keep chest and legs lifted the whole time.

items.name: Tricep Dips
items.sub: 12 reps · off a log, rock, or bench
items.detail: Hands behind you on a stable elevated surface, lower the hips straight down and press back up. Elbows track back, not out to the sides.

items.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
items.detail: High plank position, tap the opposite shoulder with each hand while keeping the hips as still as possible. Last movement before the round rest.

items.name: Bicycle Crunches
items.detail: Elbow to opposite knee, controlled rotation, exhale on the crunch. This one's about the burn, not stability — feel it in the obliques.

items.name: Flutter Kicks
items.detail: Lower back pressed into the ground, small fast kicks. Keep the legs low enough to feel it in the lower abs without the back arching.

items.name: V-Ups
items.detail: Simultaneously lift straight legs and torso to meet in a V shape, reaching for the toes. Full-range ab strength movement to close out the finisher.

workouts.title: Camp Bodyweight — Lower Body & Core Strength
workouts.subtitle: Fallback · No equipment, ~20 min · Camping trip

items.name: Leg swings, hip circles, walking lunges
items.detail: 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 10 hip circles each way, 10 walking lunges (bodyweight). Gets the hips and knees ready without any equipment.

items.name: Reverse Lunges
items.detail: Step backward into the lunge, front knee tracks over the ankle. Controlled tempo, push through the front heel to return to standing.

items.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridges
items.detail: Same setup as a regular glute bridge — on your back, knees bent, feet flat — but extend one leg straight out and drive the bridge entirely through the other planted foot and glute. Switch legs after your reps on one side.

items.name: Broad Jumps
items.detail: Jump forward as far as possible, land softly with bent knees, reset before the next rep. Explosive power movement — walk back to your start point between jumps if space is tight.

items.name: Curtsy Lunges
items.detail: Step one leg diagonally behind and across your body like a curtsy, bending both knees until the back knee nearly touches the ground. Front knee tracks over the ankle, not caving inward. Complete all reps on one side before switching.

items.name: Wall Sit
items.detail: Back flat against a tree, rock, or any vertical surface, thighs parallel to the ground. Last movement before the round rest — hold it out.

items.name: Bodyweight Sit-Ups
items.detail: Full sit-up, feet anchored if possible (or hook under a log). Controlled on the way down, not just dropping back.

items.name: Side Plank Hip Dips
items.detail: Side plank position, dip the hip toward the ground and lift back up to the starting plank height. Builds oblique strength beyond just holding a static plank.

items.name: Leg Raises
items.detail: Lying on your back, legs straight, lower back pressed into the ground, raise legs to vertical and lower with control. Straight strength-focused finisher to close things out.

workouts.title: Day B — Hinge/Pull + Core
workouts.subtitle: Tue, Sep 1 · Before date night

items.name: Leg swings, glute bridges, cat-cow, band pull-aparts
items.detail: 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 10 glute bridges, 10 cat-cow, 15 band pull-aparts.

items.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
items.detail: Switching up from the straight barbell deadlift for variety — trap bar puts the load closer to your center of mass, which is often more shoulder/back-friendly. If no trap bar is available, sub single-leg DB RDLs instead. Moderate-heavy weight, full reset between reps.

items.name: Single-Arm DB Row
items.detail: Bench-supported, full stretch at the bottom, squeeze the shoulder blade at the top. Unilateral variation instead of the usual TRX/pull-up pattern — also challenges anti-rotation core stability as a bonus.

items.name: Weighted Sit-Ups
items.detail: Hold a light plate or dumbbell against your chest, full sit-up range. This is a strength/burn movement rather than the usual stability work.

items.name: Cable Woodchoppers
items.detail: Stand sideways to a cable machine or anchored band. Pull the handle diagonally across your body — high to low or low to high — letting the rotation come from your core and hips, arms staying fairly straight, like swinging an axe.

items.name: Side Plank Reach-Unders
items.detail: Side plank position, top arm reaches under your torso and back out to the ceiling each rep. Adds a dynamic, burn-focused element to the usual static side plank.

items.name: 4 Rounds For Time: KB Clean & Press, Rower 250m, Devil Press
items.sub: 10 KB Clean & Press, 250m Row, 10 Devil Press per round
items.detail: KB Clean & Press: clean the kettlebell to shoulder height, then press overhead — one fluid motion. Devil Press: burpee with two dumbbells, snatched overhead at the top. Race the clock across all 4 rounds rather than pacing evenly — a different mental game than the usual AMRAP/EMOM.

items.name: Hip flexor, hamstring, lat stretch
items.detail: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, seated hamstring stretch, overhead lat stretch. Date night after, so give the posterior chain a proper cooldown.

workouts.title: Day A — Squat/Press + Core
workouts.subtitle: Thu, Sep 3 · AM lift, PM ride — before rehearsal dinner

items.name: Bodyweight squats, leg swings, arm circles, band pull-aparts
items.detail: 10 bodyweight squats, 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 10 arm circles each direction, 15 band pull-aparts.

items.name: Front Squat
items.detail: Switching up from back squat for variety — front-loaded position shifts emphasis to the quads and upper back. If it feels awkward on the wrists/shoulders, sub Bulgarian Split Squats (DB) instead. Moderate weight, full depth.

items.name: Landmine Press
items.detail: Wedge one end of a barbell into a landmine attachment (or jam it into a corner). Hold the free end at shoulder height with one hand, press up and slightly forward following the bar's natural arc. The fixed pivot point makes this easier on the shoulders than a straight overhead press.

items.name: Weighted Plank
items.detail: Plate on the back, standard forearm plank position. The added load turns this into a genuine strength movement rather than just an endurance hold.

items.name: Landmine Rotations
items.detail: Same landmine setup as the press. Hold the end of the bar with both hands, rotate it from hip to hip in a controlled arc, pivoting the back foot. Builds rotational core strength.

items.name: Cable Crunches
items.detail: Kneeling in front of a cable machine, rope attachment behind the head, crunch down by contracting the abs — not pulling with the arms. Loadable ab strength movement.

items.name: 4 Rounds: Assault Bike/Row Sprint, Slam Balls, Burpee Broad Jumps
items.sub: 20 sec sprint, 12 slam balls, 8 burpee broad jumps
items.detail: 20 second all-out sprint on the assault bike or rower, straight into 12 slam balls, then 8 burpee broad jumps (burpee, then a broad jump forward). Rest 60s between rounds. Short, sharp, and different from the AMRAP/chipper formats used recently.

items.name: Quad, hip flexor, chest stretch
items.detail: Standing quad stretch, kneeling hip flexor stretch, doorway chest stretch. You've got a PM ride today too, so keep this thorough.

workouts.title: Full Lift
workouts.subtitle: Mon, Sep 7 · Only lift session before backpacking trip

items.name: Bodyweight squats, arm circles, leg swings, band pull-aparts
items.detail: 10 bodyweight squats, 10 arm circles each direction, 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 15 band pull-aparts. Comprehensive full-body session today, so give the warm-up real attention.

items.name: Back Squat
items.detail: Based on your 215 lb 5-rep max. Full depth, controlled tempo. This is your main lower-body push for the week since it's the only lift session before backpacking.

items.name: Bench Press
items.detail: DB or barbell, whichever you have set up. Controlled tempo, full range of motion — main upper-body push for today's session.

items.name: Single-Arm DB Row
items.detail: Bench-supported, full stretch at the bottom, squeeze the shoulder blade at the top. Main upper-body pull for the day.

items.name: Romanian Deadlift
items.sub: 3 sets × 10 reps · DB, lighter accessory weight
items.detail: Lighter than a true deadlift working set since you already hit squats hard today — this is the hip-hinge accessory piece, not a max effort. Soft knees, hinge at the hips, feel the hamstring stretch.

items.name: Toes-to-Bar
items.sub: 3 sets × 8-10 reps · sub Hanging Knee Raises if needed
items.detail: Hang from a bar, raise straight legs to touch the bar (or bent knees toward chest as the regression). Strength-focused ab movement — control the descent, don't just drop.

items.name: Side Plank with Leg Lift
items.detail: Side plank position, lift the top leg up and lower with control for each rep. Adds a dynamic, burn-focused layer on top of the usual static side plank.

items.name: Suitcase Carry
items.detail: Heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in one hand only, walk while resisting the urge to lean away from the load. Builds anti-lateral-flexion core strength — directly carries over to running and cycling posture.

items.name: Tabata: Burpees / KB Swings
items.detail: Round 1: 20s Burpees. Round 2: 20s KB Swings. Alternate for all 8 rounds (4 rounds of each). New format today — short, sharp, and all-out for each 20-second burst rather than steady pacing.

items.name: Quad, chest, hip flexor stretch
items.detail: Standing quad stretch, doorway chest stretch, kneeling hip flexor stretch. This was a big session — take the cooldown seriously before a few days off from lifting.

workouts.title: Bodyweight + Abs
workouts.subtitle: Wed, Sep 9 · Midday, before date night · No equipment

items.name: Jumping jacks, torso twists, cat-cow
items.detail: 30s jumping jacks, 10 torso twists each direction, 10 cat-cow. No equipment needed — just get the whole body moving before the circuit.

items.name: Bear Crawls
items.detail: Hands and feet on the ground, knees hovering just above the floor, crawl forward moving opposite hand/foot together. Builds shoulder stability and core control.

items.name: Plank Jacks
items.detail: High plank position, jump the feet out wide and back together, like a jumping jack from a plank. Keep the hips stable and low the whole time.

items.name: Spiderman Push-Ups
items.detail: Standard push-up, but drive one knee out toward the same-side elbow as you lower down, alternating sides each rep. Adds an oblique/hip-flexor element to a regular push-up.

items.name: Star Jumps
items.detail: Squat down, then jump up explosively, spreading arms and legs into an X shape at the peak. Full-body explosive movement for the cardio piece of the circuit.

items.name: Squat Pulses
items.detail: Hold a squat position at the bottom and pulse up and down through a small range of motion. Burns out the legs before the round rest.

items.name: Scissor Kicks
items.detail: Lying on your back, lower back pressed into the ground, small alternating leg kicks. Keep the legs low enough that the lower back stays flat.

items.name: Toe Touches
items.detail: Lying on your back, legs straight up toward the ceiling, crunch up reaching for your toes. Upper-ab focused burn movement.

items.name: Hollow Body Rocks
items.detail: Hollow position — lower back flat, arms and legs extended — rock gently back and forth along the spine while holding the brace the entire time.

items.name: Bodyweight Russian Twists
items.detail: Seated, lean back slightly, feet can stay on the ground or lift for more difficulty, rotate side to side touching the ground each side.

items.name: Plank to Downward Dog
items.detail: From a high plank, push hips up and back into a downward dog position, then return to plank. Stretches out the whole posterior chain while still under control — good way to close out the ab work.

workouts.title: Return to Lifting
workouts.subtitle: Mon, Sep 21 · One-time Monday exception — first lift in ~2 weeks · Ladder finisher felt too easy (2:32)

items.name: Bodyweight squats, arm circles, leg swings, band pull-aparts
items.detail: 10 bodyweight squats, 10 arm circles each direction, 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 15 band pull-aparts. First lift back after roughly 2 weeks off (post-backpacking rest week) — take the warm-up seriously.

items.name: Goblet Squat (KB or DB)
items.detail: Lighter and higher-rep than your usual back squat working sets — easing back in after the break rather than jumping straight to 185-195 lbs. Full depth, controlled tempo.

items.name: DB Overhead Press
items.detail: Seated or standing, moderate weight. Fresh pressing variation from the usual bench/push press/landmine rotation.

items.name: TRX Rows
items.detail: Full range of motion, controlled negative. Body angle controls difficulty — more horizontal is harder.

items.name: Single-Leg RDL (DB)
items.detail: Hinge at the hip on one leg, opposite leg extends back for balance, DB in the opposite hand. Unilateral hinge variation — good for balance and single-leg stability after time off.

items.name: Copenhagen Plank
items.detail: Lie on your side, top leg's inner thigh/ankle resting on a bench, bottom leg hovering off the ground, hold a side-plank-like position off the bench. Brutal adductor/inner-thigh strength move — start with shorter holds if this is your first time doing it.

items.name: Standing Cable Crunch
items.detail: Rope attachment overhead, crunch down by contracting the abs while standing, not by bending at the hips.

items.name: Plank Rotations (Spiderman Plank)
items.detail: From a forearm or high plank, drive one knee out to the same-side elbow, tap, return, alternate sides.

items.name: Ladder: Burpees + KB Swings
items.sub: 1 rep each round 1, 2 each round 2... up to 6 each round 6, for time — completed in 2:32, felt too easy
items.detail: Round 1: 1 burpee + 1 KB swing. Round 2: 2 of each. Continue adding a rep each round through round 6 (6 of each). Actual result: 2:32, well under the intended difficulty — a 1-6 ladder of just two light movements is too short for this fitness level. Future ladders need a higher ceiling (e.g. 1-10, or heavier/more complex movements) to actually challenge.

items.name: Quad, chest, hip flexor stretch
items.detail: Standing quad stretch, doorway chest stretch, kneeling hip flexor stretch. First session back after a break — give the body a proper cooldown.

workouts.title: Hinge/Pull Focus
workouts.subtitle: Tue, Sep 22 · Back to real working weight

items.name: Leg swings, glute bridges, cat-cow, band pull-aparts
items.detail: 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 10 glute bridges, 10 cat-cow, 15 band pull-aparts.

items.name: Deadlift
items.detail: Back to your real working weight based on the 225 lb 5-rep max — Monday was intentionally lighter to ease back in, this session returns to normal loading. Full reset between reps, brace hard.

items.name: Pull-Ups or TRX Rows
items.detail: Pull-ups if you have a bar, TRX rows as the flexible substitute. Full range of motion, controlled negative.

items.name: Renegade Rows
items.detail: Plank position holding a dumbbell in each hand, row one side up to your ribs while stabilizing on the other arm, alternate sides. Anti-rotation stability combined with a pulling movement.

items.name: Hanging Windshield Wipers
items.detail: Hang from a bar, raise your legs and rotate them side to side like a windshield wiper. Strength-focused — scale to bent knees instead of straight legs if the full version is too much.

items.name: Weighted Russian Twist
items.detail: Seated, holding a dumbbell or plate, lean back slightly and rotate side to side touching the weight down each side. Burn/definition focused.

items.name: Ladder: DB Thrusters + Box Jumps
items.detail: Round 1: 10 DB thrusters + 10 box jumps. Then 8 of each, 6, 4, 2 — descending. Bigger jumps between rounds than Monday's ladder, and heavier/more demanding movements, so this should actually push you rather than finishing in under 3 minutes.

items.name: Hip flexor, hamstring, lat stretch
items.detail: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, seated hamstring stretch, overhead lat stretch.

workouts.title: Squat/Press Focus
workouts.subtitle: Thu, Sep 24 · AM lift before PM ride · Real working weight

items.name: Bodyweight squats, arm circles, leg swings, band pull-aparts
items.detail: 10 bodyweight squats, 10 arm circles each direction, 10 leg swings each direction/leg, 15 band pull-aparts.

items.name: Back Squat
items.detail: Back to your real working weight based on the 215 lb 5-rep max. Full depth, controlled tempo. You've got a PM ride today too, so don't grind out ugly reps chasing extra weight.

items.name: Landmine Press
items.detail: One end of a barbell wedged into a landmine attachment or corner, press the free end up and forward from shoulder height. Fixed pivot point is easier on the shoulders than a straight overhead press.

items.name: Weighted Side Bend (DB)
items.detail: Standing, dumbbell in one hand, bend directly sideways at the waist and return to upright. Burn/definition focused for the obliques.

items.name: Pallof Press to Overhead Reach
items.detail: Cable or band anti-rotation press out in front of your chest, then extend all the way overhead before returning. Combines stability work with a strength/mobility element.

items.name: Weighted Reverse Crunch
items.detail: Lying on your back holding a light dumbbell between your feet or ankles, curl your hips off the ground bringing knees toward your chest.

items.name: Man Makers
items.detail: Holding a pair of dumbbells: push-up, row one DB then the other, jump/step feet up to hands into a squat, stand up curling the DBs to your shoulders and pressing overhead, then lower back down — that's one rep. Hits nearly every muscle group per rep, so this stays short (5 min) since you're riding after.

items.name: Quad, hip flexor, chest stretch
items.detail: Standing quad stretch, kneeling hip flexor stretch, doorway chest stretch.
